_comment: Digital products. 'checkout_url' is deliberately storefront-agnostic — point it at Payhip, Selar, Gumroad, Stripe Payment Links or anything else. If checkout_url is empty the button falls back to the enquiry form with the product pre-selected, so nothing ever links to a dead checkout. Set 'available': false to grey a product out as 'in preparation'.
